national_dataset.annual_values: Daily area-averaged precipitation values aggregated by arithmetic mean for each calendar year.

city_dataset.provenance: City-level values supplied in package input. Original source metadata was not supplied; do not label this dataset NASA-derived without separate provenance.

frequency_mapping.rule: Higher rainfall = higher mapped fundamental pitch.

national.synthesis: Organic rain: granular impact bursts, 800–3000 Hz randomized impact resonances, short noise attacks, rainfall-scaled pink/band-pass ambience, and mapped-fundamental decays.

city.coverage: One file per city, synthesized from each 2005–2025 city average.
city.synthesis: Same organic rain engine and fundamental mapping as national assets.

interpretation_limits: Audio conveys comparative rainfall data. It is not a weather forecast or emergency-warning system.
Historical context records describe past events. Do not infer event causality from annual averages alone.
